CampusFlow · Individual web redesign · Batch five

Good service starts
with a clearer workspace.

Four individually redesigned staff pages: office directory, reception console, room management and teaching timetable. Dribbble references informed each purpose—not just the shared shell.

Review data, not a live campus feed. These Chromium screenshots use isolated API fixtures. This file is self-contained. Remaining work: two staff and nine admin pages; login’s final audit is tracked separately.

01 · Office services

A desk directory, not another queue board. Search service identities, review last-loaded counts and open the right reception console. Active configuration is kept separate from current opening hours.

02 · Reception workspace

The worklist keeps the student, request and next action together. A focused brief handles arrival and completion; weekly windows retain their actual weekdays.

03 · Room management

Find rooms through server search and pagination, distinguish view-only rooms, then review and deliberately save a status change. The editor is separate from the room list.

04 · Teaching timetable

A seven-day agenda with real term selection, chronological session strips and deliberate changes. Sunday is retained; publishing into another term follows the saved session.

Teaching · Focused session editor

The selected editor moves above the agenda on smaller screens. Course and term are chosen for new sessions; existing sessions retain both. These captures show an unsaved demonstration draft.

Verified, with clear limits.

  • 235 main web checks plus 21 layout checks passed. Following final copy/format cleanup, all 45 new tests and five discovery-state checks passed again.
  • Build, lint, both-client typechecks and static PHP/API gates passed. Three new Laravel feature tests were written, but could not run without PHP/backend dependencies.
  • Landing: seven protected source hashes unchanged; strict 1440 × 5065 cold/client-return comparison found zero differing channels after both student and staff stylesheet journeys.
  • Room failure keeps the draft. Office response identity must match. New teaching sessions follow their actual saved term/day. Permissions and results stay server-authoritative.
  • Full-page captures include fixed navigation at the original viewport boundary. Desktop, tablet and narrow layouts were checked; this is not a physical-device, screen-reader or live-backend certification.

Research directions: Room Booking / Terchera for the office directory; Terchera / QMS for reception; Room Booking / Stride for rooms; Studly / Terchera for teaching. Original CampusFlow iconography; no source artwork shipped.

Full comparison, attribution, subjective ten-dimension reviews and limitations: staff-services-redesign.md. Reproducible checks: staff-services-evidence.json. Completion: web-page-tracker.md.
